gloss: to leave school; to go home from school

definitions.gloss: to leave school; to go home from school
definitions.explanation: To leave the school grounds to go home at the end of the school day or during an early dismissal. Used specifically for students departing school.

examples.japanese: {三時|さんじ}に{下校|げこう}する。
examples.english: To leave school at three o'clock.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちが{元気|げんき}に{下校|げこう}していく。
examples.english: The children are heading home from school cheerfully.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で、{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}に{全校|ぜんこう}{一斉|いっせい}{下校|げこう}となった。
examples.english: Due to the typhoon, the entire school was dismissed at once during the morning.

notes:
The opposite of {登校|とうこう}する (to go to school). Specifically refers to students leaving school, not teachers or other staff.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下校|げこう}{時間|じかん}: time to leave school
- {下校|げこう}{時刻|じこく}: dismissal time
- {下校|げこう}{途中|とちゅう}: on the way home from school
- {集団|しゅうだん}{下校|げこう}: group dismissal (walking home together for safety)
- {一斉|いっせい}{下校|げこう}: all-school dismissal at once

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {登校|とうこう}する: to go to school — the antonym, describing the morning trip to school
- {帰宅|きたく}する: to go home — more general, applies to anyone returning home from anywhere, while {下校|げこう} is specific to students leaving school
- {退校|たいこう}する: to leave school (permanently) — refers to withdrawal or expulsion from a school, not daily departure
